On hand = last stocktake count + deliveries booked in − job allocations ± adjustments. "?" = never counted: count it once to start tracking. Pairs items (LEGRABOX sides, runners) are counted in pairs; L/R industrial packs are converted to pairs when booked in.

Job hardware allocations

Each CN Sync pick sheet saves an allocation file. Importing it takes that job's hardware out of stock, so the shelf numbers stay right.

Shared database

Stock, orders and jobs are kept in the team's Google script so every PC and the tablet see the same numbers. The team code is needed to change anything (ask Mason).

Trello (Orders board)

Open orders on the dashboard come live from the "2 - Orders" Trello board. If the W&B ordering app is connected on this device it uses that connection automatically.
